summary: 3 Sure-Fire Ways to Help You Renovate a Small Bathroom
title: How To Save Space In Your Bathroom - The Cheat Sheet
bodyHtml:
Are you renovating or designing a small bathroom? Well you’re not alone. As cities have become more crowded, bathrooms (and other rooms in the home) have gotten smaller. Don’t worry, we’ve put together 3 simple ways you can maximise space without making your bathroom feel pokey or dysfunctional:  

1. Basins with a projection of less than 400mm are ideal for small bathroom spaces. Additionally if you’re dealing with a truly tiny space, like a powder room, look for basins with soft or rounded edges, they’re harder to bump into!

2. In-wall cisterns are a fantastic option that can save you up to 150mm by putting the working components inside the wall. If you’re building a new home or renovating and stripping your walls right back you shouldn’t have any issues using an in-wall cistern. They also look fantastic!

3. Short projection Toilet Pans – maximise the space saving goodness of using an in-wall cistern by pairing it with a short projection wall hung or wall faced pan (like our Clear pictured below).
